pages.title: Stealth Silent Squid
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Stealth Silent Squid sends a growing tentacle through a guarded tower to free a captive squid. Recover missing tentacle parts, grab soldiers, and turn furniture into thrown weapons. Break obstacles and solve room puzzles as you work toward the cage above.

pages.title: Snow Rider Neo
pages.creator: Hangzhou Dingcheng Shiye E-Commerce Company Limited
pages.description: Snow Rider Neo puts you on a sled racing downhill through forests and mountain terrain. Steer around trees and snowballs, jump gaps, and use ramps to extend your distance. Collect gifts for paint finishes and choose between three differently handling sleds.

pages.title: Tank Challenge
pages.creator: Goolandia
pages.description: Tank Challenge pits your tank against an opponent in solo battles or matches with a friend. Aim weapons ranging from lasers to rockets and triple shots while reacting to incoming attacks. Your positioning and firing decisions determine who wins the duel.

pages.title: Dream Kitchen
pages.creator: SparkSpline
pages.description: Dream Kitchen has you prepare customer orders and serve dishes before patience runs out. Earn coins and star ratings, improve kitchen equipment, and open additional recipes. Its restaurant chapters move between pancake cooking, street food, fast food, and Western dishes.

pages.title: Gang War: Strike Shooter
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Gang War: Strike Shooter begins with a prison escape before you join the Reds or Blues in a multiplayer city conflict. Capture locations such as banks and factories to generate income, then spend the proceeds on weapons and character customization.

pages.title: The Flowers: Merge and Sell Bouquets
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: The Flowers: Merge and Sell Bouquets turns a garden into a flower-merging business. Combine blooms, sell the resulting bouquets to customers, and use pruning shears to remove unwanted plants. Build your coin earnings while competing for a leaderboard position.

pages.title: Block Master - Super Puzzle
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Block Master - Super Puzzle asks you to fit incoming pieces onto a board and complete rows or columns. Drag blocks into carefully chosen spaces to clear lines and make room. The challenge is preserving useful gaps for the pieces still to come.

pages.title: Paint Master
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Paint Master challenges you to reproduce a reference picture on a grid. Each brush activation colors a straight stretch of squares, consuming one of your limited moves. Work out the painting order so the finished pattern matches before the allowance runs out.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Quiz
pages.creator: AF
pages.description: Italian Brainrot Quiz tests whether you recognize meme characters and their unusual names. Match figures such as Tralalero Tralala and Bombardiro Crocodilo to the correct answers. Each question draws on the surreal characters associated with the Italian brainrot meme trend.

pages.title: Patterns
pages.creator: Ludo Leo
pages.description: Patterns follows Ellie through puzzles about recreating designs with elements such as grass, clouds, and fire. Select an element and a shape, then place it on the tiles to match the pattern. Stretch Mode also lets you resize shapes with arrows.

pages.title: My Pet Care Salon
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: My Pet Care Salon gives you a spa full of animals needing grooming and styling. Wash pets, trim their nails, cut their hair, and choose accessories for their new looks. Complete care activities and earn rewards while managing your salon.

pages.title: Mega Escape Car Parking Puzzle
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Mega Escape Car Parking Puzzle asks you to untangle a crowded parking lot by moving vehicles in the right order. Study which cars block an exit and guide them out without collisions. Progress through harder layouts while earning rewards and vehicle skins.

pages.title: Fishing Baron Real Fishing
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Fishing Baron Real Fishing lets you pursue different fish across locations ranging from lakes to the ocean. Begin your fishing trip, catch the species available in each environment, and unlock additional areas. Each new spot brings another selection of fish to seek.

pages.title: Aidan in Danger
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Aidan in Danger follows a slingshot-carrying elf protecting Drakor, Earth's last dragon, from an enemy crossing dimensions. Guide Aidan through platforming levels, battle monsters, and travel through time. His mission combines dangerous terrain with the fight to keep Drakor safe.

pages.title: Tower Defenders
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Tower Defenders has you hold off attacks from undead Viking warriors. Defeat the advancing enemies and put your victory rewards into stronger defenses. Continue improving your setup as you try to withstand the assault for as long as possible.

pages.title: Ragdoll Football 2 Players
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Ragdoll Football 2 Players turns a football match into a contest between floppy stick figures. Control your ragdoll, contest the ball, and try to send it into the opposing goal. Play against the computer or challenge a friend on the pitch.

pages.title: Winter Gifts
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Winter Gifts mixes platforming with puzzles about delivering Christmas presents. Pick up gifts and throw them where they need to go, helping children receive their presents. Work through each stage by using the gift-carrying and throwing mechanics to complete the deliveries.

pages.title: Woodland Slide
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Woodland Slide has you move colored jewels across wooden tracks to form matches and clear space. Plan how the gems line up as the board changes. Special abilities let you remove jewels, divide them into smaller pieces, or eliminate entire rows.

pages.title: Word Scramble - Family Tales
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Word Scramble - Family Tales combines word-search puzzles with the story of a family welcoming a child. Find the required words to continue through colorful locations and follow the family's adventure. Each puzzle gives you another set of vocabulary to uncover.

pages.title: Candy Rain 5
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Candy Rain 5 continues the candy-themed match-three puzzle series. Look for matching sweets and use your moves to work through its puzzle challenges. The fifth installment keeps the focus on finding useful matches among the different candies on the board.

pages.title: Hobo Speedster
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Hobo Speedster challenges you to balance a motorcycle across platforming tracks and reach the finish. Gather coins and diamonds to improve your bike or buy other motorcycles. Additional riders, different maps, and optional tasks give you further goals between rides.

pages.title: SnowBall Adventure
pages.creator: Abdul Wakil Mondal
pages.description: SnowBall Adventure sends a snowball rolling and bouncing through wintry stages. Collect coins as you negotiate the challenges along each route. Work through the level-based journey or switch to the endless mode to keep the rolling adventure going.

pages.title: War Nations.io
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: War Nations.io is a multiplayer territory contest in which you deploy troops to neighboring nations. Capture a target by sending an attacking force larger than its defense. Decide where to commit your soldiers as you attempt to conquer the entire map.

pages.title: Peg Solitaire
pages.creator: CoolMath Games
pages.description: Peg Solitaire challenges you to leave just one peg on the board. Drag a peg over an adjacent peg into an empty space, removing the jumped piece. Plan the sequence so the remaining pegs can still connect through legal jumps.

pages.title: PARK IT
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: PARK IT presents a series of car-parking challenges built around controlling your vehicle accurately. Drive through the assigned parking situations and complete the stages as their demands increase. The emphasis is on handling the car through increasingly difficult parking tasks.

pages.title: Join Skibidi Clash 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Join Skibidi Clash 3D combines a running course with battles against toilet monsters. Slide to steer your character through the parkour action and take part in camera-themed combat. Keep moving through the course while confronting the enemies in your path.

pages.title: Two Cups
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Two Cups follows a cup trying to restore Cupgirl after a destructive cat breaks her apart. Explore the countryside, jump through the stages, and recover her scattered fragments. Collect the pieces and confront the cat responsible for the damage.

pages.title: Kung Fu Sparrow
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Kung Fu Sparrow makes a fight over bread into a martial-arts challenge. Face opponents with different abilities as you practice your fighting skills. Earn additional belts and open bonus stages while taking on the enemies standing between you and your food.

pages.title: Become a Dentist 2
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Become a Dentist 2 puts you in charge of treating patients with painful teeth. Choose dental instruments, examine problems, and perform the indicated treatments, including injections and X-rays. Work through the mouth-care activities to deal with infections and other dental troubles.

pages.title: Crazy Dunk
pages.creator: ncsupergame
pages.description: Crazy Dunk uses taps to send a basketball bouncing upward toward the hoop. Time each input to control the ball's rise and guide it through the basket. Keep scoring as the ball rebounds, with successive goals contributing to your total.

pages.title: Cricket Live
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Cricket Live gives each player one over to build a score in multiplayer cricket. Time your batting to collect runs, then try to chase down your opponent's total. The short format makes every delivery part of the contest for the higher score.

pages.title: Police Chase Motorbike Driver
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Police Chase Motorbike Driver has you pursue criminals while patrolling the city on a motorcycle. Complete missions and collect scattered money to unlock more bikes. Watch your riding during a chase, since collisions reduce your motorcycle's health and threaten the pursuit.

pages.title: Yummy Donut Factory
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Yummy Donut Factory takes you through preparing dough, shaping donuts, and baking them. Follow the recipe's ingredient steps, then turn to decorating the finished treats. Choose toppings such as frosting, candy, and sprinkles to give your donuts their final appearance.

pages.title: Squid hero impostor
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Squid hero impostor sends a green-suited hero after enemy impostors and a hidden exit. Defeat the opponents, then locate the key needed to reveal the invisible doorway. Move through the stage while working toward eliminating the enemies and escaping.

pages.title: Idle Cars
pages.creator: GamesGate
pages.description: Idle Cars has you buy vehicles that generate money and use those earnings to expand your collection. Click the wheel button to increase their speed and production. Unlock achievements and car trophies as you work toward buying every available vehicle.

pages.title: Mike & Munk
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Mike & Munk pairs a boy with a squirrel in a cooperative escape from an abandoned mine. Control both characters as they make their way through the underground stages. Help the pair pass traps and dangerous enemies to reach safety together.

pages.title: Zombie Royale.io
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Zombie Royale.io puts you in a zombie apocalypse where defeating bosses earns money for upgrades and purchases. Move through the action while eliminating the undead threats around you. Spend your earnings to improve your chances of surviving further encounters.

pages.title: Cyberpunk Hairstyle 2200
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Cyberpunk Hairstyle 2200 gathers six princesses for a futuristic hair-styling contest. Shape their hair, apply vivid neon colors, and add technological accessories to create each entry. Complete the transformation with cyberpunk makeup that suits the hairstyle you have designed.

pages.title: Golf Solitaire
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Golf Solitaire asks you to remove the tableau by choosing cards immediately above or below the discard pile's current rank. Suits do not matter. Draw another stock card when stuck and plan your sequence to clear as many cards as possible.

pages.title: Police Chase Real Cop Car Driver
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Police Chase Real Cop Car Driver sends you after thieves, along helicopter routes, and into rescue missions around the city. Drive police vehicles, leave the car when needed, and take part in armed confrontations. Collect money to unlock additional sports cars.

pages.title: Real City Driving 2
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Real City Driving 2 lets you choose a supercar and drive around a city at your own pace. Accelerate along its streets, brake for turns, and try different vehicles. Change the camera view to see the drive from another perspective.

pages.title: Uphill Offroad Bicycle Rider
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Uphill Offroad Bicycle Rider challenges you to pedal a mountain bike through hilly courses. Control the bicycle as you negotiate climbs and attempt freestyle stunts. Each level gives you another route on which to practice balancing speed with bike handling.

pages.title: Childrens Day Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Childrens Day Differences asks you to compare two Children's Day pictures and mark everything that has changed. Find the differences before time expires, with faster completion producing a better score. A hint button can help when a detail escapes your attention.

pages.title: Rusty Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Rusty Cars Jigsaw turns photographs of weathered vehicles into picture puzzles. Select an image and a puzzle mode, then drag the scattered pieces into their correct places. Rebuild the complete rusty-car picture by matching the details across adjoining pieces.

pages.title: Goat vs Zombies
pages.creator: Paper Bunker
pages.description: Goat vs Zombies lets you cause chaos as a goat across two explorable maps. Ram zombies, wreck cars, set off bombs, and attach your tongue to objects. Search for hidden surprises or take a ride on the roller coaster while exploring.

pages.title: Offroad Animal Truck Transport
pages.creator: Matrix Info Service
pages.description: Offroad Animal Truck Transport presents cargo-driving jobs on twisting off-road tracks. Take control of the available transport vehicles and move supplies between destinations. Guide the load through the route carefully as you handle bends and difficult stretches of terrain.

pages.title: Kill The Coronavirus
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Kill The Coronavirus turns a rotating virus into a target for thrown needles. Time each launch to hit the spinning center while avoiding the projectiles already attached to it. Successful hits add points, but striking an existing needle ends the attempt.

pages.title: Hot Jewels Adventure
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Hot Jewels Adventure is a jewel-matching puzzle built around forming groups of three. Drag jewels to create matches and build your score as the board changes. Look over the gem arrangement before choosing the next move toward a higher total.

pages.title: Heavy Trucks Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Heavy Trucks Slide offers sliding-tile puzzles built from three truck pictures. Choose one of the available images and a difficulty mode, then rearrange its sections to restore the picture. Compare the truck's features to work out where each tile belongs.

pages.title: Stickman Shooter 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Shooter 2 places your fort under attack from soldiers and aliens. Shoot the approaching enemies and collect coins to strengthen your weapons between threats. Hold the defenses through successive waves as the attackers try to destroy the base.

pages.title: Steps
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Steps turns walking into a timing challenge on moving tiles. Use the mouse to place each footprint safely on the next platform, aiming for its center. Keep landing accurate steps to increase your score and unlock alternative footprint designs.

pages.title: Speedy Snake
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Speedy Snake drops you into an arena where eating scattered balls makes your snake grow. Avoid striking other snakes while encouraging them to collide with you. Collect the balls left by defeated opponents to increase your size more quickly.

pages.title: Memory Challenge
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Memory Challenge asks you to remember tile positions and choose the correct boxes after studying them. Work through 60 levels that gradually demand more from your memory. Each stage builds on the same task of recalling what you have just seen.

pages.title: Spooky Halloween Dolls
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Spooky Halloween Dolls lets you create a character and assemble a Halloween look. Pick clothing, change the doll's eyes and hair, and add face paint or mask designs. Combine the available appearance options to build your own costumed doll.

pages.title: Pumpkin Muffins
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Pumpkin Muffins guides you through making a batch of pumpkin-flavored cakes. Follow the cooking prompts and carry out the preparation activities shown on screen. Work through the recipe step by step until your muffins are ready at the end.

pages.title: Mud Truck Russian Offroad
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Mud Truck Russian Offroad puts a four-wheel-drive truck on narrow, muddy mountain tracks. Climb steep hills, steer around cliffside obstacles, and handle sharp curves without losing control. Brake carefully and adjust the camera as you tackle the demanding off-road routes.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Sibling Care
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Sibling Care has Hazel looking after Matt while their mother works in the kitchen. Help the siblings play with toys, have snacks, and respond to Matt's needs. Keep him safe and content as Hazel takes responsibility for her younger brother.

pages.title: Classical Rabbit Sniper Hunting 2019
pages.creator: TechionicsInc
pages.description: Classical Rabbit Sniper Hunting 2019 gives you a rifle and a task focused specifically on rabbits. Locate your target, zoom in, and take an accurate shot. Identify animals carefully, since the hunting instructions require you to leave other species unharmed.

pages.title: Cowboy Runner
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Cowboy Runner is an endless running game with money collection as its central goal. Keep the cowboy's run going while gathering as much cash as possible. Your attempt ends when he dies, so every extra stretch offers another chance to increase the haul.

pages.title: Police Chase
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Police Chase puts you behind the wheel of a getaway car collecting diamonds. Evade pursuing police vehicles while working toward gathering every diamond. When a patrol threatens your route, fire a rocket to remove it and continue your escape.

pages.title: Archery Strike
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Archery Strike challenges you to hit targets with carefully aimed arrows. Earn coins from shooting and spend them on additional bows and arrows. Equipment purchases also open further levels, giving you new target challenges as your archery journey progresses.

pages.title: Rebel Attack Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Rebel Attack Shooter sends you into a series of armed missions with several weapons available. Move through the battlefield, aim down your sights, and fire on enemies. Running and jumping help you maneuver while carrying out each mission's combat objectives.

pages.title: HexaLau
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: HexaLau asks you to bring together at least four hexagons bearing the same number. Drag tiles into connecting positions and clear space before newly appearing pieces crowd the board. Use the lightning option to remove an unwanted hexagon when movement becomes difficult.

pages.title: Masked Forces Crazy Mode
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Masked Forces Crazy Mode offers shooting missions across nine maps with customizable characters. Fight using selectable weapons while exploring modifiers that double movement speed, jumping strength, or armor. Choose a mode and adapt your movement and aiming to its altered conditions.

pages.title: Just One
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Just One challenges you to land a shot by setting its angle and power. Use the surrounding walls to bounce your attempt toward the goal. Successful combinations add to your score, making the route of each throw as important as its strength.

pages.title: Icy Beard Makeover
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Icy Beard Makeover asks you to help Kristoff recover from a beard-styling mishap before Anna returns. Use the makeover activities to tidy his messy facial hair and create a new appearance. Work on his beard to prepare the look he wants to show her.

pages.title: Candy Pop
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Candy Pop is a candy-matching puzzle where you arrange matching pieces and build a score. Form useful matches across the board and use special effects to remove more sweets. There is no time limit, letting you consider your next move.

pages.title: Flip Cube
pages.creator: Fast Games
pages.description: Flip Cube sends a cube past spikes by switching it between the left and right sides. Watch the approaching hazards and flip at the right moment to avoid contact. Keep the cube safe for as long as you can to extend the run.

pages.title: Steep
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Steep challenges you to descend a randomly arranged slope without leaving its surface. Move left and right around red obstacles while keeping your path under control. A mistake ends the attempt, allowing you to restart and tackle another downhill run.

pages.title: Fingers Slash
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fingers Slash asks you to keep contact with the play area while dodging hungry monsters. Move away from anything with teeth without lifting your finger. Complete its stages or test how long you can protect your finger in survival mode.

pages.title: Jewel Aquarium
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jewel Aquarium is a turn-based match-three puzzle populated by fish and sea creatures. Combine matching pieces to create explosive ones that can break obstructing blocks. Work through its levels and modes by choosing matches that help clear the underwater board.

pages.title: Pregnant Moms Exotic Holiday
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pregnant Moms Exotic Holiday has a group of pregnant princesses arrive at a tropical destination. Help them choose outfits for their time away by browsing the available clothing. Put together holiday looks that suit the exotic setting of their trip.

pages.title: Spotlight on Princess: Teen Fashion Tren
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Spotlight on Princess: Teen Fashion Tren joins Ariel's fashion talk show with Aurora appearing as a guest blogger. Explore their teenage-fashion theme and help with the princesses' looks. The styling session centers on the clothes featured in their fashion-show conversation.

pages.title: Ballzor Level Pack 1
pages.creator: QiGames Studio
pages.description: Ballzor Level Pack 1 is a physics puzzle about knocking monsters out of the play area. Aim a throw and choose a shot that sends every monster off-screen. Study their positions to work out how one well-placed impact can clear the stage.

pages.title: Brick Out
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Brick Out has you move a paddle to keep the ball striking a field of bricks. Break the entire arrangement to advance and catch useful falling power-ups. Follow the ball's rebounds so it stays in play while the remaining bricks disappear.

pages.title: 2 Dates with Fashion Princess
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: 2 Dates with Fashion Princess asks you to prepare a princess for meetings with two admirers. Browse her wardrobe and decide what she should wear for the dates. Assemble outfits that help the fashion-conscious princess feel ready for her blind-date plans.

pages.title: Samantha Plum
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Samantha Plum is a hidden-object game in which you search scenes for the requested items. Click the objects you find and finish each location's list. Your completion time and accuracy contribute to the rating awarded after the search is complete.

pages.title: Princess Coachella
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Coachella brings Elsa, Cinderella, Ariel, and Jasmine together for a music-festival styling session. Help each princess choose her outfit for the event. Combine the available festival fashions to prepare the group for their trip to the Coachella valley.

pages.title: Sudoku Deluxe
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Sudoku Deluxe presents number-placement puzzles with selectable difficulty. Fill the nine-by-nine grid so each row, column, and three-by-three region contains the digits one through nine without repeats. Use the fixed clues to work out the missing values and complete the board.

pages.title: Princess April Fools Hair Salon
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess April Fools Hair Salon has Maleficent planning hairstyle pranks for Ariel, Elsa, and Jasmine. Help her use the salon's styling options to create surprising new looks. Each princess becomes part of the April Fools makeover as her hair is transformed.

pages.title: Spring Perfect Makeup
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Spring Perfect Makeup gives you a selection of cosmetics for building a seasonal makeover. Start with foundation, then choose eyebrows and eyeshadow to suit the hairstyle. Add mascara, lipstick, and blush to complete the face you have put together.

pages.title: Real Personality Quiz
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Real Personality Quiz presents Anna's set of questions about your choices and character. Select answers and let the game total them to produce its personality result. The quiz uses your responses to assign a character profile at the end.

pages.title: Snowball Fast
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Snowball Fast is a snowball-throwing arcade game with snowmen as targets. Launch snowballs to hit them and increase your score. Watch where the targets appear and keep your throws connecting as you work toward a better total.

pages.title: Princesses On Red Carpet
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princesses On Red Carpet puts you in charge of dressing three princesses for a movie-awards evening. Browse the fashion choices and create an outfit for each attendee. Prepare the group for their appearance together on the event's red carpet.

pages.title: Goldie Princess Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Goldie Princess Skin Doctor puts Goldie in your treatment room with a skin reaction. Follow the examination and care activities, selecting the tools needed for each step. Use the clinic's equipment to treat her skin and complete the princess's recovery sequence.
